title: angraecum expansum var. genuinum
intro: Angraecum expansum var. genuinum, commonly known as the African orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in African folk medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Studies have shown that Angraecum expansum var. genuinum may possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antifungal, and anti-cancer activities, primarily due to the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The plant's bioactive constituents may contribute to its potential health benefits, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and mechanisms.
